messages.en: This car's lost a lot of its value, hasn't it?

messages.en: Have you got that shop's phone number? I want to ask if they're open today.

messages.en: Your number's still the same, right? I got a new phone and lost all my old numbers.
Still the same. I'll message you in a bit so you can save my number easily.
Okay, thanks. Include your name too, yeah? I'm worried I'll save it under the wrong name again.
Is the system back to normal? I want to submit this report.
It's back to normal. Try submitting it now.
